name: restablo-de
description: Find restaurants in Germany, browse menus and build your cart for checkout on restablo.de.

interface.longDescription:
Hungry? With restablo.de you can find restaurants near you right in the chat and put together your order.
Search for your favourite restaurant, a cuisine or a specific dish.
Browse menus with prices and offers, choose sizes and extras, and find dishes that fit your budget.
Before you finish, you get an overview of your selection and the total cost.
Via the link to the checkout on restablo.de you choose your payment method and place your order.
You need a restablo.de account to use it.
Your cart is also available on the website and in the restablo app.
The service is intended for users in Germany.
